workflows.name: Sign In (authenticate user)
workflows.on_success: flashes 'Signed in successfully.' and redirects to Accounts Overview page

workflows.name: Click Forgot Password link
workflows.on_success: navigates to Forgot Password page

workflows.name: Complete registration with valid inputs
workflows.on_success: Account created successfully — please sign in

workflows.name: Open Checking account — success
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is numeric AND Initial_Deposit_Amount >= 25 AND Funding_Source_Account balance >= Initial_Deposit_Amount
workflows.on_success: Account opened successfully! redirects to accounts overview

workflows.name: Open Checking account — deposit below minimum
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is numeric AND Initial_Deposit_Amount < 25
workflows.on_success: Real-time validation error shown for minimum deposit; account not opened

workflows.name: Open Checking account — non-numeric deposit
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is not numeric
workflows.on_success: Real-time validation error shown for numeric amount required; account not opened

workflows.name: Open Checking account — funding account insufficient
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is numeric AND Initial_Deposit_Amount >= 25 AND Funding_Source_Account balance < Initial_Deposit_Amount
workflows.on_success: Real-time validation error shown for insufficient funding account balance; account not opened

workflows.name: Open Savings account — success
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is numeric AND Initial_Deposit_Amount >= 100 AND Funding_Source_Account balance >= Initial_Deposit_Amount
workflows.on_success: Account opened successfully! redirects to accounts overview

workflows.name: Open Savings account — deposit below minimum
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is numeric AND Initial_Deposit_Amount < 100
workflows.on_success: Real-time validation error shown for minimum deposit; account not opened

workflows.name: Open Savings account — non-numeric deposit
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is not numeric
workflows.on_success: Real-time validation error shown for numeric amount required; account not opened

workflows.name: Open Savings account — funding account insufficient
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Initial_Deposit_Amount is numeric AND Initial_Deposit_Amount >= 100 AND Funding_Source_Account balance < Initial_Deposit_Amount
workflows.on_success: Real-time validation error shown for insufficient funding account balance; account not opened

workflows.name: Internal transfer between user's ParaBank accounts

workflows.name: External transfer to an external account (with account number confirmation)
workflows.on_success: Transfer completed successfully with transaction ID
